title: Yearly 年运
introduction: The year's Earthly Branch provides the annual background for the selected animal.
context: longer-term patterns, commitments and sustained changes
guidance: Review priorities over the course of the year rather than expecting a particular incident.

六合.meaning: a traditional pairing associated with connection and cooperation
六合.reflection: Consider where an agreement or common purpose could help.
六合.statement: These two branches form one of the six traditional harmonious pairs, conventionally associated with affinity and cooperation. Across the year, the theme offers a broader perspective on commitments, longer-term choices and adaptability.

六害.meaning: a traditional relationship associated with subtle friction or misunderstanding
六害.statement: These branches form a 六害 pair, traditionally describing friction or reduced ease in working together. Across the year, the theme offers a broader perspective on commitments, longer-term choices and adaptability.

相破.meaning: a traditional break relationship, sometimes associated with interruption or repair

相刑.meaning: a traditional punishment relationship associated with constraints or complicated pressures
相刑.reflection: Favor proportionate responses and avoid treating symbolism as a forecast.
相刑.statement: These branches meet a configured punishment relationship (相刑). Its traditional meaning is associated with constraint or tension, not an inevitable event. Across the year, the theme offers a broader perspective on commitments, longer-term choices and adaptability.

三会组.statement: Both branches belong to the same seasonal 三会 trio. This shared membership is not a complete three-branch meeting. Across the year, the theme offers a broader perspective on commitments, longer-term choices and adaptability.

同支.meaning: the same Earthly Branch, amplifying the shared animal symbolism in traditional readings

同支.statement: The selected animal and period share the same Earthly Branch. Traditional readings treat this as a recurrence of the branch's familiar qualities. Across the year, the theme offers a broader perspective on commitments, longer-term choices and adaptability.

常规.statement: These branches do not form one of the featured direct pairings in the site's traditional relationship tables. Across the year, the theme offers a broader perspective on commitments, longer-term choices and adaptability.
